articles.summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Nov. 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dillard’s, Inc. (NYSE: DDS) (the “Company” or “Dillard’s”) announced that the Board of Directors declared a special dividend of $30.00 per share on the Class A and Class B Common Stock of the Company.
articles.title: Dillard’s, Inc. Announces Special Dividend of $30.00 Per Share and Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.30 per Share
